notes: Canvas: Turn into › 3D in parts: each layer, or each patch of colour, its own solid; parts inside others sit on top
Model: Rig modifier: a Human, Four legs or Chain skeleton fitted to the model; pose it by dragging bones, then Apply
Rig: add, remove and name your own bones (Shift-drag from a joint); a Human rig takes the poses from Pose and .bvh motions
Rig, as Blender does it: paint weights (Add, Remove, Smooth; blue to red), IK dragging (a hand pulls its arm, elbows bend back), Keep volume, Mirror X and Symmetrize, Flip pose
Rig: keyframes on a timeline (Auto key, smooth in between, save as a video); a motion file can become keys
Model: Unwrap UVs (charts by colours and sharp edges, laid flat, packed), a checker to see them, Bake colours, Paint the texture in Canvas and bring it back
Model: Export GLB with the colours or the texture (games, Blender, the web); a rigged model goes with its bones, skin and animation (people with Mixamo names)
Rig: Any shape finds what the model is (a person, four legs, six or eight, a bird, a snake, a fish) and fits bones along its limbs
Rig › More › Motion: walk, run, idle, wave, flap, slither, swim, made for what it is as keys you can change
Rig: Jiggle on a bone: it lags behind and settles as the animation plays (tails, ears, hair)
Model: Retopology modifier: the surface made again as quads or even triangles at the number you ask for, keeping sharp edges, colours and the shape (dense AI models too)

Model, laid out like Blender: tools down the left (Edit mode adds Extrude, Inset, Knife), a one-row header that shows only what works in the mode, the view cube to turn the view (with Home, Fit and Flat view); nothing over the middle
Every slider's coloured part reaches its knob (some stopped half way)
Templates › Stickers: a die-cut sticker, a sheet of them, round stickers. The white border and the cut line grow round your art as you draw; print a sheet, or Export for your cutter

Stickers › Export for: Cricut (Print Then Cut), Silhouette (a DXF the free edition opens), Bambu Lab's cutting module, Brother ScanNCut, vinyl cutters (HPGL .plt) or a print shop, each with what to do next in its own app
Stickers: drawings too close on a sheet say so (their borders join them into one sticker); a 4 × 6 in sheet asks for 4 × 6 paper, and the Print box has it picked

Resin supports come off cleaner: each tip points square out of the surface with a snap-off neck behind it, fine details get thinner tips, tips close together share a post; paint No supports in Supports mode to keep marks off a face; Where they touch… shows every tip before slicing (click one to leave it off)

Canvas › File › Export for a machine: vinyl and iron-on (each colour its own cut, lined-up squares, a weeding box and lines; mirrored for HTV and Infusible Ink), laser (the picture engraved, cut round it: one SVG for LightBurn, xTool, Glowforge, Bambu), pen plotters (filled, outlines or line art down the middle), UV printers (colour, white ink, height) and embroidery (satin for lines and lettering, fills, underlay; DST, EXP)
Templates › Laser: keychains, coasters, earrings, signs, ornaments, bookmarks, and a box with finger joints (open, closed or with a lid; snug with the kerf allowed for)

Templates › Sublimation: mug wraps (11 and 15 oz), tumbler wraps (20 oz skinny, or a tapered one you measure, unrolled as an arc), shirt prints, coasters, a mouse pad; printed and exported mirrored, at true size
Price calculator (File, Canvas › File, or Price it next to a print's cost): materials, machine time, your time and the shop's fees (Etsy, your own shop, in person) give a price and what you keep
Canvas › File › Listing photos: your drawing on a mug, a shirt, a tote, as a sticker, a keychain and a framed print, 2000 px square
Templates › Stickers › Batch sheet: stickers from your PNG files, as many of each as you ask, packed by their shapes (turned to fit) onto one sheet to cut
Arrange this project: the open project goes on the Arrange plate as a copy, from the Arrange tab, the File menu or the empty plate
Model: Extrude shows its amount by the pointer (type a number for an exact one), and Adjust last operation changes it afterwards

Small windows: the menus fold into one button so the mode you're in keeps its name; Paint and Sculpt fold their options away (Size stays) until you pick a tool; tablet sliders show their values; Escape closes Check print
Templates › Stickers: chat stickers for Telegram, WhatsApp (under 100 KB, with its tray icon), Discord and LINE, and emotes for Twitch at all three sizes, with previews that small while you draw

Templates, what people make and sell: a keycap (Cherry MX stem, DSA, XDA or flat, your letter inlaid) and a fit test for it, a pet tag, a cake topper, a name ornament, a twisted vase, a trinket or soap dish, a card deck box, a dice tower, miniature bases, dungeon tiles; sorted by what they're for
Stickers › More › Make it a keychain: the sticker in 3D at its printed size, the border as the base, the colours on top, a ring at the top

Templates › Prints: pin-back buttons, postcards, greeting cards, business cards, bookmarks, art prints with bleed, and a mini zine drawn page by page and laid out for folding. Printed at true size with crop marks
Dialogs fit the window under the top bar, their buttons always in view; messages no longer cover a dialog or a bar along the bottom; Canvas panels stay readable over a white page
Hide panels: press ` (or View › Hide panels) for just your work; press it again to bring them back
Panels slide off the edge when you leave them, as the Windows taskbar does (the top bar too, and the view takes its room); the mouse at the edge, or a tap on the line left there, brings them back

Tablet mode, as Procreate: big buttons, fingers move the view (pinch, drag), two-finger tap undoes, three redo, four hide the panels; Canvas gets the sidebar (size, pick colour, opacity, undo, redo). On by itself when the screen is touched
Rig: bone roll, bendy bones (a bone that curves, its twist spread along it) and rules: turns with a bone, points at one, limits (Human limits: elbows and knees one way)
Pose: the chest follows the arms (lifts when they go up, presses together when they cross)
Canvas: six new filters: Motion blur, Emboss, Oil paint, Halftone, Warp, Chromatic edge
Filters: Paint puts one on with your brush; or drag on the picture to set it. All run on the graphics card
Sliders follow a pen
Panels move by their title bar (double-click to put back)
Smoother strokes when you draw fast; paint brushes no longer break up on bends
Shorter labels everywhere; less-used buttons moved into menus
Canvas: Help > Tour of the toolbox
Video: MP4 everywhere (animation, timelapse, turntable), made frame by frame; Pose motion to video
Animation: hold a frame, ping-pong, sprite sheet
Templates: 4 models, 6 Canvas sheets (video sizes, animation), 4 Pose scenes
Canvas: Turn into > 3D shape: your drawing as a puffy or flat solid in Model mode, in its colours
Layer effects: long shadow, inner shadow, colour, gradient and pattern overlays
Canvas brushes: patterns (polka, stripes, gingham, florals, hearts, lace net) and trims (lace, picot, ruffle, rickrack)
Model: Lace cuts patterned holes, Ruffle waves an edge, Displace adds honeycomb, dots, knurl, quilted, ribs
Pose clothes: a hem for skirts, dresses and capes: ruffle, lace or both
Exports: the 3MF for any program keeps colours in PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer; the Orca copy slices in Orca
Canvas: Make a brush (stamp, trim or pattern; your drawing as the tip; scatter, jitter, hue and shade; Shuffle); Chain brush
Pose patterns: Ruffle (gather, scrunch, flip), lace holes and scallops, ready skirt, dress, tiered skirt; + Curtain
Model and Pose to Canvas: line art, colours and shading in layers

Clothes move as cloth does in Blender: the same Cotton, Denim, Leather, Rubber and Silk settings at life size, checked against Blender (sag, drape, fall). Leather holds its shape, silk and chiffon flow. Drape in Model mode too

Pose: + Ready-made: 19 modelled clothes (blouse, pencil skirt, T-shirts, jeans, shorts, leggings, suit, padded jacket, overalls) with their seams, stitching and buttons; they fit any body and move with it, then drape as cloth
Pose: Ready-made skirts that flow (A-line, circle, ruffled, maxi): fastened at the waist and free below, they hang, swing when she walks and flare when she twirls; leather keeps its shape
Clothes collide with the body, with everything in the scene (sit her on the park bench) and with themselves; a skirt put on a seated figure is put on standing and she sits back down in it
Clothes: each garment's own Tension, Compression, Shear and Bending (Blender's numbers, under ⚙); ready-made skirts' waistbands shrinkwrapped flush; a mini skirt

Ready-made: 19 skirts from the MakeHuman community (each maker credited); modelled clothes go on in the pose they were made for and she moves into hers, so they start clean; seams sewn, see-through lace

Skirts as they are sewn: at the natural waist on a waistband, the fullness all at the hem; new pleated and tiered ruffle skirts; heavier fabrics by default, and cloth that buckles into folds instead of crumpling
Cloth on the graphics card: big garments (4,000 points and up) simulate there, tens of thousands of points live; the same results as before, checked against Blender
Pose: Ready-made › Made from her body: T-shirt, long sleeves, jacket, trousers, shorts cut from her own body, with Room to make them looser; modelled clothes get a Fit slider from roomy to hugging
Cloth: damped as Blender damps it (its springs and bending), so fine fabric settles instead of shimmering; hems and cuffs drawn with the fabric’s thickness
Export for a machine › Vinyl: cut two colours from one vinyl (Cut with…), and weeding lines that go through the gaps between letters
Laser: six dither styles (Floyd, Jarvis, Stucki, Atkinson, Ordered, Halftone) and score lines in blue (the outline, or line art down its middle)
UV printer: the white pulled in from the edge (choke), gloss all over or on the raised parts, and a PDF with RDG_WHITE and RDG_GLOSS for Roland VersaWorks (or White and Gloss for other RIPs)
Embroidery: Brother PES files (Brother and Baby Lock), threads matched to Brother’s chart
Laser box: dividers that slot together and lock into the walls, and a lid hinged on a band of slits in the back
Price calculator: pick the currency, sales tax or VAT, and prices saved by name
Listing photos: folds in the shirt and the tote that the print follows, a bevelled mat round a framed print, shade on the mug, a sticker’s edge
One STL per filament: each a closed solid now (painted colours 1 mm deep, the rest the part’s own filament), so PrusaSlicer, Cura and the rest load them as parts that fit together
